job_slave_terran_desc: Extraer información de diferentes especies y sancionar a los esclavos es la fortaleza de los torturadores.Extracting information from different species and enacting punishments to slaves is the forté of torturers.
job_slave_vidiian_desc: ¿Cuánto cuestan los órganos frescos de una nueva especie con una compatibilidad del 99% con la fisiología de Vidi? No lo sé, pero estos subastadores de esclavos para los vidianos ciertamente lo hacen.How much do fresh organs from a new species with a 99% compatibility with Vidiian physiology go for? I don't know, but these slave auctioneers for the Vidiians certainly do.
job_soldier_UND_desc: Agentes de la ondina especialmente modificados, con capacidad de adoptar la apariencia de otras especies.Specially modified agents of the Undine, with the ability to take on the appearance of other species.
job_soldier_gunner_desc: Un soldado cuya vida se satisface observando los cielos y derribando aviones enemigos.A soldier whose life is satisfied by watching the skies and bringing down enemy aircraft.
job_soldier_superior_gladiator_desc: Los que luchan por el deporte son una raza diferente a los que lo hacen por necesidad. Los gladiadores a menudo se vuelven más grandes que la vida, con grandes seguidores.Those who fight for sport are a different breed to those who do it out of necessity. Gladiators often become larger than life, with huge followings.
job_spawning_drone_borg_desc: Utilizando dosis de nanites, los drones de guardería pueden asegurar el crecimiento continuo del Colectivo Borg.Utilising doses of nanites, nursery drones can ensure the continued growth of the Borg Collective.
job_starfleet_admiral_desc: Oversees strategic operations, commands fleet formations, and makes high-level decisions for Starfleet.
job_starfleet_captain_desc: Commands the starship, makes important decisions and represents Starfleet in all missions.
job_starfleet_commander_desc: Assists the captain in managing the crew and takes over his duties in his absence.
job_starfleet_pilot_desc: Responsible for navigating and steering the ship through space.
job_starfleet_recruit_desc: This recruit was top of his class at Starfleet Academy.
job_student_desc: Educar a los jóvenes para el futuro es de vital importancia para las naciones que viven en el espacio.Educating the youth for the future is of vital importance to space-faring nations.
job_surgeon_denobulan_desc: Los apretados grupos de familias comunales de Denobula son generalmente dirigidos por cirujanos muy respetados y reconocidos.The tight groups of communal families of Denobula are generally led by surgeons who are well respected and renowned.
job_synapse_drone_borg_desc: El lanzamiento de ciertas operaciones complejas requiere unidades clave dentro del Colectivo, controladas por Adjuntos Primarios para garantizar el funcionamiento continuo de los drones a través del consenso unificado.The firing of certain complex operations requires key units within the Collective, controlled by Primary Adjuncts to ensure the continual operation of drones across the unified consensus.
job_talos_observer_desc: Los observadores atienden al Menagerie, buscando una especie para repoblar el planeta.The observers tend to the Menagerie, seeking a species to repopulate the planet.
job_terraformer_desc: La operación de maquinaria compleja usada en situaciones de terraformado es usualmente dejada a Terraformadores calificados, quienes pueden estudiar los cambios planetarios que están ocurriendo.The operation of complex machinery used in terraforming situations is usually left to qualified Terraformers, who can study the planetary changes that are occuring.
job_test_pilot_desc: Conducts flight tests to evaluate and refine new technologies and systems.
job_tosk_desc: Los Tosk son una raza de reptiles nativos del cuadrante Gamma. No tenían designaciones personales, y "Tosk" -una vez que uno era consciente del papel de los Tosk en su sociedad nativa- resumía casi todo sobre ellos y su propósito en la vida.Tosk are a reptilian species native to the Gamma Quadrant. They don't not have personal designations, and 'Tosk' - once one is aware of the role of the Tosk in their native society - pretty much sums up everything about them and their purpose in life.
job_undine_artisan_desc: Artistas de Undine especialmente criados que esculpen la Bio-materia para crear productos únicos para Undine Hive.Specially bred Undine artists who sculpt the Bio-matter to create unique goods for the Undine Hive.
job_undine_factory_desc: Drones especialmente desarrollados para recolectar aleaciones de la superficie de los planetas.Specially bred drones developed to harvest alloys from the planets surface.
job_undine_infester_desc: Los infestantes organizan y controlan la infestación en un planeta.The infesters marshal and manage the infestation on a planet.
job_undine_livestock_desc: Los orgánicos inferiores no tienen cabida en la sociedad Undine, son acorralados listos para ser infestados y descompuestos para reabastecer las reservas de biomasa.The inferior organic have no place in Undine society, they are rounded up ready to be infested and broken down to resupply the biomass reserves.
job_undine_organic_battery_desc: La temida máquina no tiene cabida en la sociedad de Undine, se acorralan listas para ser infestadas y se descomponen para reabastecer las reservas de biomasa.The dreaded machine has no place in Undine society, they are rounded up ready to be infested and broken down to resupply the biomass reserves.
job_undine_toiler_desc: Los recolectores de ondinas recorren el espacio fluídico en busca de recursos para el conjunto.Undine Gatherers scour Fluidic space for resources for the whole.
